notes.title: CORN is released!
notes.content:
Play for free now and receive the exclusive [b]Never Forget Corn[/b], available today only, which will surely be worth like $90 in a few months.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078390/CORN/][img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3078390/ss_1b3937e36508764ce078509498dade3980252e57.1920x1080.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]About CORN[/h3]
CORN is an interactive clicker game, in which you click on corn! Get random corn every few hours and grow your collection. Full steam inventory and market integration. Limited edition corn rotate in and out of the drop pool on a weekly basis. Special corn grant special effects. Buy corn, sell corn, collect corn, craft corn, love corn. Corn!

[h3]Why CORN?[/h3]
Corn is a versatile crop that is widely used in various industries, mainly food production. Corn syrup, derived from corn, is a key component of many American delicacies, such as soda and cereal. Corn is heavily subsidized by the CIA, to the tune of over 9 billion dollars per year. Simply put, you can't go wrong with corn!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list][*]Collect corn.
[*]Buy corn.
[*]Sell corn.
[*]Craft corn.
[*]Daily corn drops.
[*]Corn is better than banana.
[*]Participate in the e-corn-omy.
[*]Click corn, make funny number go up.
[*]Special corn grant special effects.
[*]Corn is in fact a fruit, stop trying to correct me.
[/list]
[h2]Play for free now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078390/CORN/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078390/CORN/[/url][/h2]

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
* Landmines damage increased, but no knockdown anymore.
* New toggle option in config menu (F2) to disable energy drink. For achievementchads only.
* "Laser attack" improved, damage lines up with visuals now (prior version had a 0.05 sec desync between damage and visuals).

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ World Championship Event
notes.content:
[b]Update 1/23/2024: All prizes have been claimed, congrats to the winners.[/b]

The [b]TYRONE SOULZ World Championship Event[/b] has begun! The only game where you can win money by killing Tyrone. Wow.

[h3][b]Duration:[/b][/h3]
Now through 1/23/2024 11:59PM PST (subject to extension, idk).

[h3][b]Criteria:[/b][/h3]
Record yourself unlocking achievements in TYRONE SOULZ, and submit your videos on the [url=https://discord.gg/X5KwsjMJUU]Discord server[/url]. The [b]first person[/b] who gets each achievement will receive a prize.

[h3][b]Achievements + Prizes:[/b][/h3]

• [b]Racist[/b] - Kill Tyrone ($10 Steam gift card)
• [b]Dehydrated [/b]- Kill Tyrone without drinking any energy drinks ($15 Steam gift card) 
• [b]Blaze It[/b] - Kill Tyrone in less than 04:20 ($20 Steam gift card)
• [b]What A Melon[/b] - Kill Tyrone after he feasts ($25 Steam gift card)
• [b]Supreme Racist[/b] - Kill Tyrone without taking any damage ($25 Steam gift card)

One of these (undecided as of now) will also come with an extra 'yet to be determined' reward. 

If you stream your winning attempt on Twitch/Youtube, I'll throw in an extra $5. Please stream my game.

[h3][b]Rules:[/b][/h3]
• Only video submissions will be accepted, and they must be complete from start to end. No screenshots. Quality must be good.
• Scores are timestamped and must be submitted within 48 hours.
• Breaking the game is encouraged, but anything I deem too much of an exploit will invalidate your submission.
• I can add to or change these rules at any time and you will deal with it.

[h3][b]Links:[/b][/h3]
Submit your score via Discord: https://discord.gg/X5KwsjMJUU
